address.scope: random hostname under lhr.life for one connection
conditions: trial: uptime and URL lifetime are not guaranteed
a new connection gets a new URL
the plan limits a session to 15 minutes

cost.summary: The free tier costs nothing and needs no signup; its domains change regularly and have a speed limit.

disclosure.text: Start a public HTTPS trial through the localhost.run relay for the requested lifetime (15 minutes by default). The relay terminates TLS and can read payloads.

protocols.sse/streamableHttp: true. Backed by validation.sse (timed incremental event delivery when required) and validation.publish (exact-origin approval only after all required probes) in the wrapped recipe definition, with admission.requiredFeatures probe-assertions and client-vantage-probe.
protocols.oauthDcr: oauthDcr false: free domains are ephemeral ('Domain names change regularly'), so no stable HTTPS origin.
